objective: Determine which finite-graph transport permanence/safety bounds are uniform as mesh spacing tends to zero, including state dimension, transport scaling, local volume, affine slopes, and absorber constants.

claims.claim: For a fixed finite local endotactic reaction family in fixed species dimension d, the supplied deterministic affine-barrier corollary yields a compact positive invariant range K for any number of compartments when each edge uses the same scalar transport coefficient for every species. K is independent of graph size, topology, and the magnitude of locally bounded edge coefficients, including coefficients proportional to h^-2.

interface.initial_data: Each cell concentration belongs to one fixed compact Q0 subset of the positive orthant.
interface.reaction: A fixed finite local reaction family, with bounded supplied rates; the source's common-species transport corollary permits local measurable mixtures.
interface.transport: Nonnegative locally bounded scalar edge coefficients, identical across species on each edge.

claims.proof: The local affine minimum F_s uses fixed slopes r_lambda in R^d. For G=min_(v,lambda) L_(lambda,s)(x_v), an active label at v satisfies L_(lambda,s)(x_w)>=G=L_(lambda,s)(x_v) for every w. Hence r_lambda dot sum_w m_vw(x_w-x_v)=sum_w m_vw(L_(lambda,s)(x_w)-L_(lambda,s)(x_v))>=0. The reaction derivative at an active label is nonnegative; the source's compact plateau is therefore invariant. The sign proof is independent of N_h and m_vw.
claims.consequence: A mesh family with concentrations initially in Q0 has an h-independent all-time L-infinity bound and positive coordinate lower bound.
limitations: This is invariant-range confinement from bounded positive initial profiles, not an all-data classwise absorber or a uniform entry time for arbitrary spatially unbounded initial data.
PDE convergence still needs a specified consistent mesh, discrete coercivity/compactness, and convergence of h-dependent reaction controls.
claims.source: Local 7 October reconstruction, d-326696af15b5e02b.html, sections 'Switching, convex mixtures, and invariant transport' and 'Common-species transport on arbitrary finite topologies', especially lines 739-924.

claims.claim: Under shape-regular quasi-uniform finite-volume assumptions on a fixed bounded domain, the common-scalar invariant range gives a subsequential reaction-diffusion PDE limit that remains in the same compact positive convex K. The same conclusion holds for diagonal species diffusion when every facet normal of K is a common nonnegative left eigenvector of every edge diffusion matrix and the diffusivities are uniformly elliptic.

uniformity_criterion.transport_normal_test: For each facet normal a_i and edge matrix A^h_vw, require (a_i)^T A^h_vw=mu^h_i,vw (a_i)^T with mu^h_i,vw>=0.
uniformity_criterion.reaction_test: At each site, the local reaction field points into K on each active facet; uniform boundedness on K is required for compactness.
uniformity_criterion.mesh_test: Symmetric conservative consistent graph Laplacian; discrete H1 energy equivalent to the piecewise-constant gradient; diffusivities bounded below; initial interpolants converge in L2.
uniformity_criterion.controls_test: For the finite reaction list, coefficient fields are fixed or have a weak-* convergent subsequence.

claims.proof: The eigenvector condition turns edge transport on facet i into sum_w mu_i,vw [g_i(x_w)-g_i(x_v)]>=0 whenever x_v is on that facet and all x_w are in K, so Q^N is invariant. Uniform boundedness of reactions on K and the symmetric diffusion identity yield a uniform L-infinity_t L2_x bound and an integrated discrete H1 bound. The equation bounds time derivatives in discrete H^-1. Standard discrete Rellich/Aubin-Lions compactness gives a strongly L2-convergent subsequence; closed convexity of K gives u(t,x) in K almost everywhere. Strong concentration convergence and weak-* rate convergence pass the bounded polynomial reactions to the weak PDE.
claims.limitation: This is a conditional compactness and limit statement, not supplied as a theorem by the reaction-network source.

claims.claim: For the stochastic graph exit estimate with a transported facet, D_h=kappa h^-2 and bounded degree give eta_i(h)=Theta(h^2), Q_i(h)=Theta(h^-2), theta_i(h)=Theta(h^2), rho_i(h)=Theta(h^4), and B_i(h)=O(1). The displayed estimate is useful uniformly over N_h~h^-p sites and time T only if V_h h^4 dominates log N_h+log(V_h T), in addition to the source's fixed local V_h>=V0 requirement.
claims.exact_bound: P(tau_Q<=T)<=N_h sum_i exp(-V_h theta_i(h) zeta_i)+V_h T N_h sum_i B_i(h) exp(-V_h rho_i(h)).
claims.physical_scaling: If local volume V_h=Omega_h h^p, then the load-bearing exponent is Omega_h h^(p+4). Fixed Omega_h=Omega violates V_h>=V0 as h->0 and sends the formal exponent to zero. A polynomial high-density scaling sufficient for this certificate is Omega_h h^(p+4)/log(1/h)->infinity for fixed T.
claims.reaction_rescaling: A reaction changes concentration by nu/V_h and fires at intensity V_h k phi^V_y(X), so the drift is k phi^V_y(X)nu -> k X^y nu. The finite-volume factorial correction is at most D_i/V_h with D_i=K sum_r |a_i dot nu_r| E_(y_r)(U); V_h>=V0=max(1,max_i ceil(2D_i/gamma_i)) preserves half the supplied margin. This local threshold is independent of N_h but fails under fixed-density voxel scaling V_h=Omega h^p.

costs.event_count_over_T: O(V_h T h^(-p-2)); other controller, random-bit, event-selection, and output costs are not included

limitations: The stochastic graph theorem assumes common species hopping; it is not a theorem for unequal species diffusivities.
The bound is finite-horizon confinement, not infinite-time survival, stochastic permanence, or a continuum limit.
Facets orthogonal to transported species may have better scaling; one transported facet with the displayed scaling controls the minimum exponent.
claims.source: Local 7 October report, d-84257a69e61b9b47.html, exact interface/proof at lines 1-135 and mesh/refinement discussion at lines 190 onward.

claims.claim: The local strict-inward reaction polytope Q={1<=x<=3, 1<=y<=3, x+y>=3} is not automatically invariant under species-dependent transport, even with linear reactions 0<->A and 0<->B having drift (2-x,2-y). On two sites, A hopping at alpha/h^2 and B at beta/h^2 with beta>alpha gives both sites initial lower-sum-facet gap epsilon; the first-site facet gap becomes negative by time c h^2 for the explicit h-range below.
claims.active_facet: The first site exits through the lower sum facet x_(1,A)+x_(1,B)-3=0. Both initial site gaps are exactly epsilon>0.
claims.parameters: alpha=1, beta=3, c=log(3)/4, epsilon=1/1000 give g_h(c h^2)=1-(1-epsilon)e^(-c h^2)(1+1/(3 sqrt(3)))<0 whenever h^2<(4/log(3))*log[(999/1000)(1+1/(3 sqrt(3)))], a positive threshold about 0.63720237. Since g_h(0)=epsilon>0, the exact certified upper bound on the first exit time is tau_h<=c h^2; the first zero need not equal c h^2. The limit is epsilon-(1-epsilon)/(3 sqrt(3))<0.
claims.independent_exact_check: At h=1 and t=log(100/99), the gap is -1621541844091699/200000000000000000. This rational value was recomputed exactly with fractions.
claims.continuum_falsifier: For D_A=3,D_B=1 and initial profiles x=3/2-(1/10)(1-cos(4z)), y=3/2+(1/5)(1-cos(4z)), the smooth positive data lie in Q and touch the sum facet at z=0. There the PDE gap derivative is 1+3(-16/10)+16/5=-3/5, so the solution immediately leaves Q.
claims.scope_limit: This falsifies transfer of this product-polytope/affine certificate. It does not show absence of another absorber or failure of permanence for the stable linear example.

claims.claim: The affine family uses a finite slope set fixed before its auxiliary scale and lies in local dimension d. Its strict drift in the scale box is delta_s=kappa H s^M after K L s^H<=kappa H, and the plateau lies within [sqrt(s),s^-1/2]^d. For a fixed local network these constants do not depend on mesh size when reused sitewise; the source supplies no useful uniform lower bounds on H or s_P, or upper bounds on W_s, across varying network families or if the whole dN graph is treated as one growing-dimensional network.
claims.consequence: The sitewise common-scalar transport corollary is the valid route to h-uniform confinement; silently applying the single-network absorber theorem in dimension dN does not establish uniform constants.
claims.source: N33-endotactic-permanence card lines 7-10 and local source d-326696af15b5e02b.html sections 'Finite affine minima', 'A common absorber on an unbounded class', and 'Common-species transport'.

unknowns: General unequal-species-diffusion classwise permanence for the stated all-endotactic measurable-rate class.
A useful fixed-density h->0 stochastic exit estimate or continuum stochastic permanence theorem from the C06 graph certificate.
Uniform quantitative bounds on the affine slopes, H, final plateau scale, and entry time over a growing family of reaction systems or growing state dimension.
External correctness, formal verification, and novelty/priority of the internal N33 and C06 claims.
